about_the_game:
◆◇◆ The Rise and Fall of the Sect Lies in Your Hands ◆◇◆

Money—yes, with wealth and resources, your sect becomes the strongest, especially for a female-dominated sect. Hurry and recruit genius disciples, train them, and let them cultivate, while ordinary disciples are left to do menial labor. Of course, they will rebel, and fleeing disciples may take half your resources with them! How ruthless you are is up to you. Strengthen your sect, annihilate invading enemies, challenge higher-tier sects, and rise to become the most powerful sect in the cultivation world!

"Sect Rising: Chronicles of the Crimson Cultivators"—Your choices will reshape the laws of the cultivation world!

"This is no ordinary cultivation simulator—you must play both the iron-fisted sect master and the scheming strategist!"

◆ When expanding your sect, will you shackle laborers with cold iron chains to till the spirit fields, or enlighten them with wisdom-bestowing pills?

◆ When facing a powerful enemy, will you sacrifice 3,000 outer disciples to minimize resource loss, or spend a fortune to activate the sect's protective formation and spare their lives—after all, they’re weak and die so easily!
